Lieutenant '''Landalin''' was a [[Kandori]] soldier who was stationed at [[Heeth Tower]].

== Activities ==
He was in command on the tower top when a huge army of [[Trolloc]]s were seen approaching the tower. It can be assumed he did not survive the encounter.

== Trivia ==
* Landalin is named for Landon Williams, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
